latest_build_code.description: Build number (the +N in pubspec version) of the newest APK on GitHub Releases. Apps with a lower build number show 'Update available'. Set by scripts/release.ps1.

latest_version_name.description: Human-readable version shown in the update dialog.

min_build_code.description: Builds below this MUST update (dialog can't be dismissed). Raise only for security fixes or breaking backend changes.

apk_url.description: Where the newest APK is downloaded from. Must be https.

defaultValue.value: প্রথম পাবলিক ভার্সন: ভয়েস/লিখে কমান্ড, রিমাইন্ডার, কাজ, খরচ, কে কত পাবে/দেবে, রসিদ স্ক্যান, বলোর মুখ, এবং স্বয়ংক্রিয় আপডেট নোটিফিকেশন।
First public build: voice/typed commands, reminders, tasks, expenses, who-owes-whom, receipt scan, Bolo's face, and automatic update alerts.
